title: Repairs from final review of Due dates and priority
description:
Repairs routed from the epic's final review (tick 58o). Apply exactly these; nothing else.
1. src/lib/tasks/repository.ts: escape LIKE wildcards in q: replace `\`, `%`, `_` with `\\`, `\%`, `\_` and use `LIKE '%' || lower(?) || '%' ESCAPE '\'`. Integration test: with titles "100% done", "100 done", "a_b", "axb": q "100%" matches only "100% done"; q "a_b" matches only "a_b". In docs/current/how/scheduling.md say that matching is a case-insensitive substring, wildcards are literal, and SQLite folds ASCII case only (`mælk` does not match `MÆLK`).
2. src/app/components/task-list.tsx (and page.tsx if needed): the empty-state paragraph "No tasks yet. Add the first one above." renders only when show is undefined or "all" and both lists are empty and q is empty; with show=open and no open rows render the "Open (0)" heading. Update task-list.test.tsx (a case: show "open", no rows → "Open (0)" heading and no empty-state text) and the `open` row of the sections table in how/scheduling.md.
3. docs/current/how/scheduling.md: fix the `q` row of the query-parameter table: the SQL fragment with `||` breaks the table; move the SQL out of the table into the sentence below it (keep the table cell as prose: "case-insensitive substring on the title").
4. src/app/components/task-fields.tsx: replace the local `TaskFieldValues` / `TaskFieldErrors` type declarations with `import type` of the equivalent types from "@/lib/tasks/validate" (export a `SubmittedValues` type there if needed: `export type SubmittedValues = ReturnType<typeof submittedValues>`), so a new field is added in one place.
5. src/lib/db/open.integration.test.ts: in the "0002 on a db that already had 0001" test, insert a task after 0001 and assert after 0002 it reads back with priority 2 and due_on NULL.
6. src/lib/tasks/repository.integration.test.ts: make the tie-break discriminating: set the fake clock backwards before one insert so a higher id has an older created_at, and assert created_at wins over id.
7. e2e/scheduling.spec.ts: move the cleanup delete into `test.afterAll(async ({ browser }) => { const page = await browser.newPage(); ... })` so it runs even if an earlier serial test fails; keep the assertions of the last test that do not depend on the delete (or drop that test if it only deleted).
Run: pnpm typecheck && pnpm lint && pnpm test && pnpm docs:check
